About the Scholarship

The European Politics and Society (EPS) Václav Havel master is a two-year Erasmus Mundus programme starting in Prague and continuing through partner universities such as Leiden, Kraków and Vienna. For the 2027/28 intake applications open on 1 November 2026, with an early-bird deadline of 28 February 2027 for scholarship candidates and a regular round until 30 April 2027. Prior English-medium study is accepted as English proficiency evidence - a new test certificate is not always needed.

The European Politics and Society (EPS) Václav Havel master is a two-year Erasmus Mundus programme starting in Prague and continuing through partner universities such as Leiden, Kraków and Vienna. For the 2027/28 intake applications open on 1 November 2026, with an early-bird deadline of 28 February 2027 for scholarship candidates and a regular round until 30 April 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Named after Václav Havel and coordinated by Charles University with four European partners
  • Interdisciplinary training in politics, economics, history and governance of Europe
  • Two admission windows: early-bird (28 February 2027) and regular (30 April 2027)
  • Double-degree pathways and a strong alumni network in EU institutions and think tanks

Who Should Apply

Open to graduates in political science, international relations, economics, history, area studies and related disciplines. Applications are free of charge; English proficiency must be documented with the standard tests or prior English-medium study.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships in the early-bird round cover participation costs plus a monthly allowance; self-funded places are available in both rounds.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the EPS application portal from 1 November 2026; scholarship candidates should target the early-bird round because funding is allocated there first. Key deadline information: 28 February 2027 (early-bird round); regular deadline 30 April 2027 — applications open 1 November 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

English language requirements

English proficiency can be documented either through the standard tests (IELTS, TOEFL or accepted equivalents) or through evidence of prior English-medium study, so applicants with degrees taught in English can apply without a new test certificate.

About EPS Consortium (Charles University)

The EPS consortium is led by Charles University in Prague and delivers the Václav Havel Joint Master in European Politics and Society with partners in the Netherlands, Poland and Austria. The programme is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master funded by the European Union.

Official website: https://epsmaster.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 28 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
